Critical primary component enabling ion transport between electrodes. Usually lithium salt dissolved in organic solvents. Essential for battery function and completely separate manufacturing process.
Primary safety and functional component - porous polymer membrane preventing electrode contact while allowing ion flow. Manufactured separately and essential for preventing short circuits.
Primary structural components - copper foil for anode and aluminum foil for cathode. Conduct electrons to external circuit and provide mechanical support for active materials.
Primary protective component housing all internal elements. Can be cylindrical, prismatic, or pouch format. Manufactured separately and critical for safety and structural integrity.
Primary electronic component controlling charging/discharging, monitoring cell health, and ensuring safety. Complex PCB with sensors and control circuits, manufactured as separate unit.
Primary system for temperature control including coolant channels, heat exchangers, and thermal interface materials. Critical for performance and safety in EV applications.
Primary structural component holding multiple cells together in modules and overall pack assembly. Provides mechanical protection and structural integration with vehicle.

Structural protection and containment for all internal components. Provides mechanical integrity, weatherproofing, and crash protection - universally required.

Electrical connections between individual cells to create the required voltage/current configuration. Fundamental for series/parallel cell arrangements.
Safety switches that can disconnect high voltage power when needed. Critical safety component for maintenance and emergency situations.
Overcurrent protection devices that prevent electrical faults from causing damage. Standard safety requirement in all EV battery systems.
Mechanical framework that holds cells in position and prevents movement during vehicle operation. Important for structural integrity and vibration resistance.
